metadata.title: GPCR cellular function II: agonism and antagonism
metadata.note: Raw author and database records are retained. Author CSV structure extraction is not an independent redraw of all structures. Exposure uncertainty is disclosed and is not replaced with guessed timing.

M001.context: Human TWNT-4 hepatic stellate cells; compound preincubation 1 h, then 1 uM LPA for 30 min; inhibition of MRTF-A nuclear translocation. The author reports an EC50 for this LPAR1-associated downstream functional response.
M001.context_evidence: Author structure/MRTF-A CSV; original SI Table S1 confirms MRTF-A values and Table S2 footnote TWNT4 plus 1 uM LPA. Source-specific ChEMBL CHEMBL6104090 describes nuclear translocation; author antagonist interpretation retained.

raw_record.assay_context: TWNT-4 MRTF-A response to LPA; distinguish downstream response from proximal receptor engagement

M002.context: CHO cells expressing human GPR119; cAMP accumulation measured by HTRF after 90 min; agonist EC50.
M002.context_evidence: Author CSV and source-specific ChEMBL assay CHEMBL6156165; EC50 does not specify intrinsic efficacy.

raw_record.assay_context: Human GPR119 expressed in CHO, HTRF cAMP; original methods need check

M003.context: CHO cells expressing 5-HT1A receptor; 15 min compound incubation; agonist-induced ERK1/2 phosphorylation by AlphaLISA; functional EC50.
M003.context_evidence: Author CSV ERK1/2 pEC50 column and source-specific ChEMBL CHEMBL6120022. Emax, cAMP and beta-arrestin columns are distinct; EC50 does not imply full agonism.
